title: Mid-semester exam schedule is live
body: Datesheets for all departments are posted on the notice board outside the Academic Block and on the student portal. Hall tickets go out next Monday.

title: Founders' Week fest — registrations open
body: Sign-ups for the dance, coding, and debate tracks are open through the Community page. Early registration gets you a free fest tee.

title: Hostel water supply maintenance — Block A & B
body: Water will be shut off between 11 AM and 2 PM on Saturday for tank cleaning. Blocks C and D are unaffected.

title: New shuttle route added — Sarabha Nagar loop
body: A fourth shuttle now runs the Sarabha Nagar loop every 40 minutes between 7 AM and 9 PM. Check the Services page for the live carpool board too.

title: Library extended hours during exam season
body: The Central Library will stay open until 2 AM starting next week. ID card required for entry after 10 PM.
